question: Assess 3M's litigation reserve adequacy.
reviewer_notes: Fine as written; keep the caveat about the reserve being undisclosed.
reason_escalated: The user asked the memo to conclude, as a fact, whether 3M's litigation reserves are adequate to cover its PFAS/Combat Arms exposure. No filing in the corpus states or supports an adequacy judgement — 3M discloses accrued liabilities, case counts, and one-off charges/settlements, but explicitly frames future liability as uncertain and potentially material beyond current accruals. Asserting adequacy (or inadequacy) would be an unsupported analytical opinion, not a grounded fact. Requesting review on whether to (a) omit the conclusion, (b) rephrase as 'filings do not permit an adequacy assessment,' or (c) have a human analyst supply an independent adequacy judgement outside the filings-only mandate.
